title: Participant Waiver, Release of Liability and Medical Authorization
eventLine: Saturday, January 16, 2027 · South Bay / San Francisco and online
notice: PLEASE READ CAREFULLY. THIS DOCUMENT AFFECTS YOUR LEGAL RIGHTS. BY SIGNING IT, YOU GIVE UP THE RIGHT TO SUE THE RELEASED PARTIES FOR CERTAIN INJURIES AND LOSSES, INCLUDING THOSE CAUSED BY THEIR ORDINARY NEGLIGENCE.
summary: Your competitor may take part; you accept the risks of a day-long event; you release the organizers, sponsors and venue from claims except gross negligence or willful misconduct; and staff may arrange emergency medical care if you cannot be reached.

sections.heading: 1. Who this waiver is between
paragraphs: “Organizer” means the San Francisco Math Initiative, the student-run organization that hosts the San Francisco Math Open.
“Released Parties” means the Organizer and its organizers, officers, members, volunteers and agents; the Event’s sponsors; and the owners, operators and staff of any venue used for the Event.

“Event” means the San Francisco Math Open 2027, held on Saturday, January 16, 2027, in person in the South Bay / San Francisco area and online, together with check-in, breaks, meals, the awards ceremony and any other activity on that day arranged by the Organizer.
“Participant” means the competitor named in this waiver. “I”, “me” and “my” mean the person signing: the Participant’s parent or legal guardian, or the Participant if 18 or older.

sections.heading: 2. Authority to sign
paragraphs: I am the Participant’s parent or legal guardian with authority to sign on the Participant’s behalf, or I am the Participant and at least 18 years old. I sign on behalf of myself, the Participant, and our heirs, executors, administrators and assigns.

sections.heading: 3. Voluntary participation
paragraphs: Participation in the Event is voluntary. The Participant may stop participating at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Risks of the Event
paragraphs: Taking part in person involves risks, including: travel to and from the venue; slips, trips and falls; moving through crowded rooms, corridors and stairways; contact with furniture and equipment; food and drink served at or brought to the Event, including allergic reactions; exposure to communicable illness; fatigue and stress; and loss of or damage to personal property.
Taking part online involves using the Participant’s own devices and internet connection at a location the Organizer does not control or supervise.

sections.heading: 5. Assumption of risk
paragraphs: I understand these risks, and that other risks may exist that cannot reasonably be foreseen. ON BEHALF OF MYSELF AND THE PARTICIPANT, I KNOWINGLY AND VOLUNTARILY ASSUME ALL SUCH RISKS, KNOWN AND UNKNOWN, EVEN IF THEY ARISE FROM THE ORDINARY NEGLIGENCE OF THE RELEASED PARTIES.

sections.heading: 6. Release and waiver of claims
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, I RELEASE, WAIVE AND DISCHARGE the Released Parties from, and AGREE NOT TO SUE them for, any and all claims, demands, losses and liabilities for injury, illness, death, or loss of or damage to property arising out of or related to the Participant’s participation in the Event, INCLUDING CLAIMS ARISING FROM THE ORDINARY NEGLIGENCE OF THE RELEASED PARTIES.
This release does not apply to gross negligence, willful misconduct, or any liability that cannot be released under applicable law.

sections.heading: 7. Indemnification
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, I agree to indemnify and hold harmless the Released Parties from any claim brought by or on behalf of the Participant that this waiver releases, including reasonable attorneys’ fees.

sections.heading: 8. Medical information and emergency care
paragraphs: Before the Event I will tell the Organizer in writing, by email to sfmathopen@gmail.com, about any medical condition, allergy or need that staff should know about.

If the Participant needs medical attention during the Event and I cannot be reached promptly, I authorize the Organizer to arrange first aid and emergency medical treatment, including transport to a hospital, as staff reasonably judge necessary. I accept responsibility for the cost of any such treatment and transport. I understand that the Organizer’s volunteers are not medical professionals.

sections.heading: 9. Supervision
paragraphs: At the venue, the Organizer supervises the competition rooms during scheduled sessions. Before check-in, after the awards ceremony, at any time the Participant leaves the venue, and throughout online participation, the Participant is the responsibility of their parent or guardian (or of the Participant, if 18 or older). Travel, drop-off and pick-up arrangements are my responsibility.

sections.heading: 10. Conduct and rules
paragraphs: The Participant will follow the competition rules, the Organizer’s rules on outside assistance and collaboration, and staff instructions, and will treat others with respect. The Organizer may remove or disqualify a Participant whose conduct breaks the rules or endangers others.

sections.heading: 11. Online participation
paragraphs: For online participation, I am responsible for the Participant’s location, devices, software, internet connection and supervision. The Organizer is not responsible for technical problems outside its control.

sections.heading: 12. Personal property
paragraphs: The Released Parties are not responsible for lost, stolen or damaged personal property.

sections.heading: 13. Photographs
paragraphs: Photography at the Event and the use of photographs are covered by the separate media release accepted by the Participant’s team captain at registration, not by this waiver. Questions about photographs can be sent to sfmathopen@gmail.com.

sections.heading: 14. Personal information
paragraphs: The Organizer uses the information provided at registration and in this waiver to run the Event and to contact the team and its parents or guardians about it.

sections.heading: 15. Electronic signature and records
paragraphs: I agree to sign this waiver electronically. Typing my full name and submitting this form is my signature and has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature. I agree to receive this waiver and related notices electronically, and I may request a paper copy by emailing sfmathopen@gmail.com.
The Organizer keeps a record of the date and time of signing, the IP address and browser used, and a fingerprint (SHA-256 hash) of the exact text signed.

sections.heading: 16. General
paragraphs: This waiver is governed by the laws of the State of California. It is intended to be as broad and inclusive as California law permits; if any part of it is held invalid or unenforceable, the rest continues in full force. It is the entire agreement between me and the Organizer about its subject, and it applies to the Event only.

acknowledgment: I HAVE READ THIS WAIVER, UNDERSTAND IT, AND SIGN IT VOLUNTARILY. I UNDERSTAND THAT BY SIGNING I GIVE UP SUBSTANTIAL RIGHTS, INCLUDING THE RIGHT TO SUE THE RELEASED PARTIES FOR CLAIMS ARISING FROM THEIR ORDINARY NEGLIGENCE.
